issue_context.title: [Theming] gdscript autocomplete color selection hides the text
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.dev.20210916.official [104a6191f]

### System information

manjaro Gnome 21, AMD R7 200 series, Intel i3 3.0 GHZ,8GB RAM

### Issue description

When the autocompleter shows, the color hides the text:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/58845030/133889632-b9459a04-deba-4ee3-973e-cd69ba2ec7de.png)

as you can see, the text doesnt show well, where highlighted!

### Steps to reproduce

* just type a function call in gdscript

### Minimal reproduction project

N/a

review_comments: This just looks like a typo (0.13 is clearly supposed to be the alpha). I would just fix it without completely changing the value.
